# When?

When? is a bilingual PT-BR / English browser chronology game created by Turetta. Its name is never translated.
Players sort four historical-event cards from oldest to newest in each of six rounds.
Guests can complete a game without signing in; guest attempts, scores, analytics, and personal data are not recorded. Only games played after Google sign-in are saved and eligible for the global Top 10 leaderboard. Authenticated accounts have a three-games-per-day limit.

Canonical site: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/
Leaderboard: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/leaderboard
Privacy policy: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://tempo-certo-6ccc2.web.app/terms

Public round and answer documents support write-free guest play. Authenticated attempts and leaderboard credits are validated by Cloud Firestore Security Rules.

Repository: https://github.com/HigorTuretta/play-when
